text:
رتی کھائے رتّ نوں، ماسا کھائے ماس،
تولا کھائے ہڈیاں، دم دا کیہہ بھرواس۔
romanized:
Rattī khāe ratt nūṅ, māsā khāe mās,
Tolā khāe haḍḍīāṅ, dam dā kih bharwās.
literal_en:
Eating one ratti of opium destroys the blood, a māshā destroys the flesh,
A tola destroys the bones, what hope of life is left?

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
